payout_quote: Texas: jurors are paid by the county not less than $20 for the first day and not less than $58 for each day after the first (state statutory minimums).
steps: Receive a Texas state court jury summons
Receive at least $20 for day one and $58/day thereafter (county may pay more)
catches: These are minimums — actual pay is set by each county's commissioners court.
biggest_catch: County-set actuals; the state only guarantees the $20/$58 minimums.
eligibility: Persons summoned for jury service in Texas courts.
timing: Per day of attendance, paid by the county.

c1.evidence: Texas Judicial Branch official juror-information page (txcourts.gov).
